## Inputs and next obligations

Frozen session denominator: [data/state-holdings/manifest-inputs.json](../../data/state-holdings/manifest-inputs.json). Atomic classification/move plan: [data/state-holdings/move-plan.json](../../data/state-holdings/move-plan.json). Typed reader mapping: [lib/holdings/datasets.ts](../../lib/holdings/datasets.ts).

Every future canonical holding under data/states/<st>/ is discovered automatically. A new state's first registry, snapshot, vault artifact or obligation makes its manifest required; --check fails until the generated answer exists. Undeclared dataset-to-surface mappings fail generation and must be classified. External readbacks are refreshed only by their explicit acquisition command, never by generation, handoff --check or CI.
